<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four boys have an average mass of $50 \ \text{kg}$ and 
six girls have an average mass of $40 \ \text{kg}$. What 
is the average mass of the ten children?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four boys have an average mass of $50 \ \text{kg}$ and 
six girls have an average mass of $40 \ \text{kg}$. What 
is the average mass of the ten children?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Average mass}     &= \dfrac {\text{Mass of boys} + \text{Mass of girls}} {\text{Total children}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {4 \times 50 + 6 \times 40} {4 + 6} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {200 + 240} {10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {440} {10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {44 \cancel{0}} {1 \cancel{0}} \\\\
                        &= 44  \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$44 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

For the first $12$ months after I bought my new phone I downloaded $4$ apps to it each month. Over the next $7$ months I only downloaded $1$ app each month, but this month I downloaded $5$ new apps. What is the average number of apps I have downloaded each month while I have had the phone?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">For the first $12$ months after I bought my new phone I downloaded $4$ apps to it each month. Over the next $7$ months I only downloaded $1$ app each month, but this month I downloaded $5$ new apps. What is the average number of apps I have downloaded each month while I have had the phone?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Average number of apps}       &= \dfrac { (12 \times 4) + (7 \times 1) + (1 \times 5) } { 12 + 7 + 1 } \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac { 48 + 7 + 5 } { 20 } \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {60} {20} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {20} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{20} \times 3} {\cancel{20}} \\\\
                                    &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a wet week in Rusholme the mean (or average) rainfall over the five days from Monday to Friday was $12 \ \text{mm}$. 
On Monday, when the rain was heaviest there was $22 \ \text{mm}$, but on Friday there was only $5 \ \text{mm}$ of rain.  

What was the mean rainfall on the other three days?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a wet week in Rusholme the mean (or average) rainfall over the five days from Monday to Friday was $12 \ \text{mm}$. 
On Monday, when the rain was heaviest there was $22 \ \text{mm}$, but on Friday there was only $5 \ \text{mm}$ of rain.  
<emptyline>
What was the mean rainfall on the other three days?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the average rainfall for other three days $= r$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {22 + 3r + 5} {5}                     &= 12 \\\\
\dfrac {27 + 3r} {5}                         &= 12 \\\\
27 + 3r                                      &= 12 \times 5 \\\\
27 + 3r                                      &= 60 \\\\
3r                                           &= 60 - 27 \\\\
3r                                           &= 33 \\\\
r                                            &= \dfrac {33} {3} \\\\
r                                            &= \dfrac {11 \times 3} {3} \\\\
r                                            &= \dfrac {11 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
r                                            &= 11 \ \text{mm}
\end{aligned}
$

Average rainfall $= 11 \ \text{mm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11\ \text {mm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The mean length of a crocodile is $7.5 \ \text{m}$ and the mean length 
of an alligator is $4 \ \text{m}$. If I have $4$ crocodiles and $6$ alligators 
what would be the mean length of all $10$ creatures together?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The mean length of a crocodile is $7.5 \ \text{m}$ and the mean length 
of an alligator is $4 \ \text{m}$. If I have $4$ crocodiles and $6$ alligators 
what would be the mean length of all $10$ creatures together?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mean length}      &= \dfrac {4 \times 7.5 + 6 \times 4} {4 + 6} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {30 + 24} {10} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {54} {10} \\\\
                        &= 5.4  \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5.4 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tim has three apples. The mean (average) weight of the three apples is $90 \ \text {grams}$. When Tim eats the largest apple, the mean weight of the remaining two apples is just $70 \ \text {grams}$.

What was the weight of the largest apple?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tim has three apples. The mean (average) weight of the three apples is $90 \ \text {grams}$. When Tim eats the largest apple, the mean weight of the remaining two apples is just $70 \ \text {grams}$.
<emptyline>
What was the weight of the largest apple?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight for the largest apple (in $\text{grams}$) $= a$

$\text{Average weight} = \dfrac {\text{Total Weight}} {\text{Total Apples}}$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mean weight of } 2 \text{ apples}     &= 70 \\\\
\text{Total weight of } 2 \text{ apples}    &= 70 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= 140  \ \text {grams}
\end{aligned}
$

Using the average weight for $3$ apples, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a + 140} {3}    &= 90  \\\\
a + 140                 &= 90  \times 3 \\\\
a + 140                 &= 270 \\\\
a                       &= 270 - 140\\\\
a                       &= 130 \ \text {grams} 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$130 \ \text {grams}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The **average** weight of five parcels is $3.7 \  \text{kg}$. Four of the parcels are identical and each weigh $3.5 \  \text{kg}$. What is the weight of the fifth parcel?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The **average** weight of five parcels is $3.7 \  \text{kg}$. Four of the parcels are identical and each weigh $3.5 \  \text{kg}$. What is the weight of the fifth parcel?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of the fifth parcel (in kg) $= w$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Average weight}           &= \dfrac {\text{Weight of all the parcels}} {\text{Total parcels}} \\\\
3.7                             &= \dfrac {3.5 \times 4 + w} {5} \\\\
3.7 \times 5                    &= 3.5 \times 4 + w \\\\
3.5 \times 4 + w                &= 3.7 \times 5 \\\\
14 + w                          &= 18.5 \\\\
w                               &= 18.5 - 14  \\\\
w                               &= 4.5  \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of the fifth parcel $= 4.5 \ \text {kg}$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4.5 \ \text {kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The **average** height of three boys is $1.29 \ \text{metres}$.  A fourth boy Stephen, whose height is $1.21 \ \text{metres}$, joins the group. Find the new **average** height of the group.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The **average** height of three boys is $1.29 \ \text{metres}$.  A fourth boy Stephen, whose height is $1.21 \ \text{metres}$, joins the group. Find the new **average** height of the group.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total height of 3 boys}   &= 3 \times 1.29 \\\\
                                &= 3.87 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{New average height}       &= \dfrac {3.87 + 1.21} {4} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5.08} {4} \\\\
                                &= 1.27 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.27 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two more boys, Richard and Nigel, join the group.  The new **average** height of all six boys in the group is $1.28 \ \text{metres}$. If Richard is $1.26 \ \text {metres}$, how tall is Nigel?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two more boys, Richard and Nigel, join the group.  The new **average** height of all six boys in the group is $1.28 \ \text{metres}$. If Richard is $1.26 \ \text {metres}$, how tall is Nigel?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the height of Nigel $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1.29 \times 3 + 1.21 + 1.26 + a} {6}    &= 1.28 \\\\
\dfrac {3.87 + 1.21 + 1.26 + a} {6}             &= 1.28 \\\\
\dfrac {6.34 + a} {6}                           &= 1.28 \\\\
6.34 + a                                        &= 1.28 \times 6 \\\\
6.34 + a                                        &= 7.68 \\\\
a                                               &= 7.68 - 6.34 \\\\
a                                               &= 1.34 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

Height of Nigel $= 1.34 \ \text{m}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The four numbers $8,\ 3,\ 9$ and $\boxed{\phantom{15}}$ have an average of $6$.


What number goes in the box?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The four numbers $8,\ 3,\ 9$ and $\boxed{\phantom{15}}$ have an average of $6$.
<emptyline>

What number goes in the box?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {8 + 3 + 9 + a} {4}              &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac {20 + a} {4}                     &= 6 \\\\
20 + a                                  &= 6 \times 4 \\\\
20 + a                                  &= 24 \\\\
a                                       &= 24 - 20 \\\\
a                                       &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

The missing number $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the missing number $= a$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {8 + 3 + 9 + a} {4}              &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac {20 + a} {4}                     &= 6 \\\\
20 + a                                  &= 6 \times 4 \\\\
20 + a                                  &= 24 \\\\
a                                       &= 24 - 20 \\\\
a                                       &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
The missing number $= 4$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When each diagram below is complete the number in the middle of each group of $3$ adjoining cells is the average of its two neighbours. Fill in the missing numbers.

| $5$     |       | $9$     |       |       |
|:-------:|:-----:|:-------:|:-----:|:-----:|

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When each diagram below is complete the number in the middle of each group of $3$ adjoining cells is the average of its two neighbours. Fill in the missing numbers.
<emptyline>
| $5$     |       | $9$     |       |       |
|:-------:|:-----:|:-------:|:-----:|:-----:|
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

| $5$   | $a$   | $9$   |  $b$     |   $c$   |
|:-----:|:-----:|:-----:|:--------:|:-------:|  

Let the missing numbers $= a, b, c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a                       &= \dfrac {5 + 9} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {14} {2} \\\\
a                       &= 7 \\\\
\dfrac {a + b} {2}      &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac {7 + b} {2}      &= 9 \\\\
7 + b                   &= 9 \times 2 \\\\
7 + b                   &= 18 \\\\
b                       &= 18 - 7 \\\\
b                       &= 11 \\\\
\dfrac {9 + c} {2}      &= b \\\\
\dfrac {9 + c} {2}      &= 11 \\\\
9 + c                   &= 11 \times 2 \\\\
9 + c                   &= 22 \\\\
c                       &= 22 - 9 \\\\
c                       &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

Missing numbers $= 7, 11, 13$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

After the first 5 weeks of the holiday, Stuart has earned an average of $\pounds 11$ per week. In his sixth week he earns $\pounds 23$. What is his new average weekly wage?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">After the first 5 weeks of the holiday, Stuart has earned an average of $\pounds 11$ per week. In his sixth week he earns $\pounds 23$. What is his new average weekly wage?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New average} &= \dfrac{11 \times 5 + 23}{6} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{55 + 23}{6} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{78}{6} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{6 \times 13}{6} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{\cancel 6 \times 13}{\cancel 6} \\\\
                   &= 13
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The test scores of five pupils were:

$9,\quad 10,\quad 9,\quad 7,\quad 5$

Whats is the mean (or average) score?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The test scores of five pupils were:
<emptyline>
$9,\quad 10,\quad 9,\quad 7,\quad 5$
<emptyline>
Whats is the mean (or average) score?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Average score}    &= \dfrac {9 + 10 + 9 + 7 + 5} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {40} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {8 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5} \\\\
                        &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When a sixth pupil sat the test the mean score stayed exactly the same.  

Find the score of the sixth pupil. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When a sixth pupil sat the test the mean score stayed exactly the same.  
<emptyline>
Find the score of the sixth pupil. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the score of sixth pupil $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {9 + 10 + 9 + 7 + 5 + a} {6}             &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac {40 + a} {6}                             &= 8 \\\\
40 + a                                          &= 8 \times 6 \\\\
40 + a                                          &= 48 \\\\
a                                               &= 48 - 40 \\\\
a                                               &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Score of sixth pupil $= 8$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As the mean did not change after adding the score of sixth pupil, the score for the sixth
pupil must be the same as the mean.

Score of sixth pupil $= 8$

$8$

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: If there is an odd number of numbers, the median is the middle number. If there is an even count of numbers, the median is the average of the middle two numbers.
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Median}                &= \dfrac {4 + 6} {2} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {10} {2} \\\\
                             &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Rainfall**

The table shows information about the rainfall in two places in South America.

| Place     | Season     |    Mean rainfall                 | Number of months     | Months          |
|:-----:    |:------:    |:----------------------------:    |:----------------:    |:-------------:  |
|   $A$     |   Dry      |   $10\, \text{cm per month}$     |        $8$           |  Jan to Aug     |
|           |   Wet      |   $20\, \text{cm per month}$     |        $4$           | Sept to Dec     |
|   $B$     |    Dry     |   $5\,\text{cm per month}$       |        $10$          | July to Apr     |
|           |    Wet     |   $50\,\text{cm per month}$      |         $2$          | May to June     |


Which of the places has **more rainfall** on average over the whole year? 

Show working to explain your answer.

Tick $(\checkmark )$ your answer.

- $A$

- $B$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Rainfall**
<emptyline>
The table shows information about the rainfall in two places in South America.
<emptyline>
| Place     | Season     |    Mean rainfall                 | Number of months     | Months          |
|:-----:    |:------:    |:----------------------------:    |:----------------:    |:-------------:  |
|   $A$     |   Dry      |   $10\, \text{cm per month}$     |        $8$           |  Jan to Aug     |
|           |   Wet      |   $20\, \text{cm per month}$     |        $4$           | Sept to Dec     |
|   $B$     |    Dry     |   $5\,\text{cm per month}$       |        $10$          | July to Apr     |
|           |    Wet     |   $50\,\text{cm per month}$      |         $2$          | May to June     |
<emptyline>

Which of the places has **more rainfall** on average over the whole year? 
<emptyline>
Show working to explain your answer.
<emptyline>
Tick $(\checkmark )$ your answer.
<emptyline>
- $A$
<emptyline>
- $B$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Mean} = \dfrac {\text{Total of items}} {\text{Number of items}}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mean of place A}      &= \dfrac {10 \times 8 + 20 \times 4} {8 + 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {80 + 80} {12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {160} {12} \\\\
                            &= 13.3 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Mean of place B}      &= \dfrac {5 \times 10 + 50 \times 2} {8 + 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {50 + 100} {12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {150} {12} \\\\
                            &= 12.5 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Place A has more rainfall on average compared to place B.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

A

</div>
